ticket.subject: Pages take 30+ seconds
ticket.body_text:
Dear Support Team,

I look after our account at Tidewell Logistics. Since 10:50 UTC the whole app has been extremely slow for everyone at Tidewell Logistics: pages take more than 30 seconds to load.

People at other companies are posting about the same thing.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. Please look into it.

Kind regards,
Rafael

label_notes: clean outage (outage-slow): the whole service is degraded for many users but still usable, so P2; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
